description: This file defines the Customer model class within the Opencart admin module, providing methods for managing customer data, addresses, histories, transactions, rewards, IPs, authorizations, tokens, and related database interactions.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: This class provides comprehensive CRUD and querying functionalities for customer entities within the OpenCart admin module, including management of addresses, histories, transactions, rewards, IPs, authorizations, and tokens.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database with provided data and returns the new customer ID.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer record identified by customer_id with the provided data.

methods.name: editCommenter
methods.description: Sets the commenter status for a specific customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Removes a customer and related data from the database, including activities, addresses, authorizations, histories, rewards, transactions, wishlists, IPs, tokens, and affiliates.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a customer record by customer_id, including custom fields decoding.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a customer record based on email address.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Fetches a list of customers with optional filtering, sorting, and paging.

methods.name: getTotalCustomers
methods.description: Returns the total count of customers matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Counts customers belonging to a specific customer group.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Deletes activity logs of a customer.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a new address for a customer.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates a customer's address.

methods.name: deleteAddresses
methods.description: Deletes one or all addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific address, including country and zone details.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Fetches all addresses associated with a customer, decoding custom fields.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByCountryId
methods.description: Counts addresses by country ID.

methods.name: getTotalAddressesByZoneId
methods.description: Counts addresses by zone ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history comment to a customer record.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history entries for a customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves customer history logs with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts customer's history records.

methods.name: deleteWishlists
methods.description: Deletes all wishlist items for a customer.

methods.name: deleteWishlistByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes wishlist items filtered by store ID.

methods.name: deleteWishlistByProductId
methods.description: Deletes wishlist items filtered by product ID.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new transaction record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactions
methods.description: Deletes all transactions of a customer.

methods.name: deleteTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes transactions linked to a specific order.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for a customer with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Counts total transactions for a customer.

methods.name: getTransactionTotal
methods.description: Sums transaction amounts for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalTransactionsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts transactions tied to a specific order.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points for a customer.

methods.name: deleteRewards
methods.description: Deletes reward records for a customer.

methods.name: deleteRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward points associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Retrieves reward records with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Counts reward records for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Sum of reward points for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalRewardsByOrderId
methods.description: Count rewards linked to an order.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Removes IP records for a customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves IP address logs for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Counts IP records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByIp
methods.description: Counts customers by IP address.

methods.name: getTotalLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves login attempt record for a given email.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Deletes login attempt records for an email.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Removes customer authorization records.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets total authorization attempts for a customer.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves a specific authorization record by ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Fetches authorization record using customer ID and token.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Gets authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Counts authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Creates a token for customer authentication.

methods.name: deleteTokens
methods.description: Removes all tokens for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Deletes a token by its code.
